_comment: Hand-maintained registry of tokenized-equity TOKENS for the /stocks terminal. Curation rule: a token is listed ONLY if (1) its exact address (EVM lowercase; Solana base58 kept case-exact because base58 is case-sensitive) appears in data/pools-snapshot.json underlyingTokens, AND (2) there is positive evidence it is a tokenized equity/ETF. ISSUER ATTRIBUTION is by exact address only: `issuer` is a display name (a key of `issuers`) and is set ONLY with `issuerSource` naming where that exact address was verified (the issuer's own published address list/API, an on-chain read, or the issuer's official announcement); `issuerBasis` says which. A symbol convention or address prefix (the 0xb2000... Base prefix is shared by non-equity B20 tokens, and `R`/`B`/`ON` symbol conventions collide across issuers) is NEVER evidence: such tokens stay `issuer: "unverified"` with an `issuerHint`. Pools are matched by ADDRESS only, never by ticker substring, so FARTCOIN/PEPECOIN/BITCOIN/TONCOIN/BOTCOIN/STONK-type memecoins can never match. Third-party wrapper (W-prefix), vault (beefy, superform) and synthetic (DeFiChain dToken) representations are excluded; issuer-published wrapper tokens whose address the issuer itself lists (ST0x wt*, xStocks wrapperAddressV2) are listed. Add a token only with an address copied from the snapshot; extend `excluded` with a reason when you reject a candidate.
